description_en: Invokes the DescribeAutoScalingConfig operation to query the elastic scaling feature configuration of an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoScalingConfig接口，查询实例弹性伸缩功能配置信息
name: DescribeAutoScalingConfig

Data.description_en: The elastic scaling feature configuration of the instance
Data.description_zh: 实例弹性伸缩功能配置信息

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth elastic scaling feature configuration of the instance
Bandwidth.description_zh: 实例带宽弹性伸缩功能配置信息

BandwidthUsageLowerThreshold.description_en: The average bandwidth usage threshold that triggers automatic bandwidth downgrade. Unit: %
BandwidthUsageLowerThreshold.description_zh: 触发带宽自动回缩的带宽平均使用率阈值，单位为%

BandwidthUsageUpperThreshold.description_en: The average bandwidth usage threshold that triggers automatic bandwidth upgrade. Unit: %
BandwidthUsageUpperThreshold.description_zh: 触发带宽自动扩展的带宽平均使用率阈值，单位为%

Downgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic bandwidth downgrade is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Downgrade.description_zh:
带宽自动回缩是否开启：

true：是。
false：否

ObservationWindowSize.description_en:
The observation window for automatic bandwidth upgrade. The value consists of a number and a time unit suffix. The time unit suffixes are:

s: seconds.
m: minutes.
h: hours.
d: days. 

For example, 5m indicates 5 minutes
ObservationWindowSize.description_zh:
带宽自动扩展的观测窗口。返回值由数值和时间单位后缀组成，其中时间单位后缀含义如下：

s：表示秒。
m：表示分钟。
h：表示小时。
d：表示天。 

例如，返回5m表示5分钟

Upgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic bandwidth upgrade is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Upgrade.description_zh:
带宽自动扩展是否开启：
true：是。
false：否

MaxSpec.description_en:
The maximum specification for automatic scale-up. For details, refer to the product specification documentation for each database instance:
<props="china">

For PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition, see [Compute node specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html）.
For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL high-availability series with cloud disks, see [Product specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276974.html）.
For Redis community cloud disk edition, see [Instance specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144986.html）.

</props>

<props="intl">

For PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition, see [Compute node specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html）.
For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL high-availability series with cloud disks, see [Product specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276974.html）.

</props>
MaxSpec.description_zh:

RDS MySQL高可用系列云盘版请参见[产品规格]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276974.html）。

</props>
